001: Ivan, have you already decided where we'll go on vacation?
I'm still thinking between Petersburg and Kazan. Which one do you like more?
I would choose Kazan. They say it's very beautiful there in the fall.
Really? And I heard that there are a lot of interesting exhibitions in Petersburg right now.
Then let's look at tickets and decide based on the price.
Okay, I'll compare the options in the evening and text you.
002: Dmitry, have you already booked a hotel for the May holidays?
Not yet, I just can't pick one. I want something not far from the center.
I saw a great option near the embankment, it has parking.
Great! Send me the link, please, I'll take a look.
Of course, I'll send it. Just keep in mind that prices are going up every day.
I understand, then I'll decide today so I don't change my mind.
003: Sergey, have you already put together the route for our trip to the mountains?
Almost. I want to include a couple of lakes and one viewpoint.
Sounds wonderful. And how many days will we need?
I think four days will be enough if we leave early in the morning.
Then I suggest we rent a car so we don't depend on the schedule.
Agreed, that will be more convenient. I already looked at the prices, everything is within the budget.
004: Olga, have you already bought the train tickets to Sochi?
Yes, I got the morning train so we arrive before dark.
Smart. And do you already have the return tickets too?
Not yet, I'm waiting for my vacation to be confirmed at work.
I hope it all works out. By the way, I found an inexpensive hotel by the sea.
Great, send me the name, I'll check the reviews.
005: Anna, have you already decided what you'll take with you on the trip?
I'm planning to take only carry-on luggage so we don't have to wait for checked bags.
That's reasonable. But what about souvenirs for the relatives?
I'll buy something small, like magnets and local tea.
Right, that's always a good option. And have you already checked the documents?
Yes, I put the passport and insurance in a separate folder.
006: Alexey, have you already chosen how we'll get to Vladimir?
I think it's better to take the commuter train, it's faster and no traffic jams.
Agreed, otherwise by car we could get stuck for a long time.
That's exactly what I thought. Tickets can be bought right at the station.
Great. And what do you plan to see in Vladimir?
I want to visit the Golden Gate and the local kremlin.
007: Maria, have you already booked a table at the restaurant for our evening?
Yes, I reserved it for seven o'clock, a window table with a view of the river.
Wonderful! And what kind of cuisine do they have there, have you already looked at the menu?
Yes, they mostly have Russian cuisine, but they also have European dishes.
Sounds great. And how will we get there?
I suggest we walk, it's only twenty minutes from the metro.
008: Elena, have you already decided which country we'll celebrate the New Year in?
I'm currently leaning towards going to Tbilisi. It's warm there and the food is good.
Oh, that's an interesting idea. And have you already looked at tickets?
Yes, there are inexpensive options for the twenty-eighth of December.
Then let's not put it off and buy them while there are still seats.
Agreed, I'll make the booking today.
009: Dmitry, have you already thought through what we'll do on the first day in Murmansk?
I want to go straight to the coast and see the northern lights.
That would be great! And have you already found a guide?
Yes, I arranged it with a local tour guide, he'll meet us at the hotel.
Great. And what about the second day?
I'm planning a trip to Teriberka, if the weather allows.
010: Ivan, have you already prepared everything for our trip to Kaliningrad?
Almost. I just need to print the tickets and download the maps.
Good. And did you forget about the visa? Is it still valid?
Yes, I checked, the visa is valid until the end of the month.
Great, so we don't have to worry about anything.
Agreed. We just have to wait for Friday and pack the suitcase.
